# 06 — Delivery model file format

*Derived from `vrp/servicemodel.py`, `models/`.*

A delivery model is an operation described as data: everything except today's demand. The key set below is *computed* from the coverage contract, so it cannot drift from the domain model.

## Top-level keys

Fields: `assignment`, `declinable`, `fleet`, `order`, `quantity`, `route`, `run`, `service`, `shift`, `windows`.

Structural: `applies_to`, `base`, `name`, `problem_id`, `set`, `tunable`, `use`.

## Deliberately not settable

| Domain type | Field | Why not |
|---|---|---|
| Location | `access_classes` | Which vehicles a site admits is a fact about the site. The model's half of FR-11 is the vehicle's access_class, which is covered. |
| Location | `dock_capacity` | How many bays a depot has is a property of that depot, and FR-19 makes it site data rather than policy. |
| Location | `id` | Site identity arrives with the demand, not with the operation. |
| Location | `inventory` | What a depot holds changes daily. FR-31 makes it a per-run input, and a model carrying it would be yesterday's stock. |
| Location | `lat` | Geography arrives with the demand, not with the operation. |
| Location | `lon` | Geography arrives with the demand, not with the operation. |
| Location | `matrix_index` | Assigned while building the matrix for one round; it means nothing outside that round. |
| Location | `max_vehicle_kg` | A bridge or a yard's weight limit belongs to the place. The model's half is the vehicle's gross_weight_kg. |
| Order | `id` | The delivery record's own identifier. A model describes how work is served, never which work exists. |
| StopSpec | `location_id` | The delivery's own site, which arrives with the demand. A model that named locations would be a round rather than a way of running rounds. |
| Vehicle | `charger_locations` | Which sites have chargers is geography, and arrives with the locations. A model that carried it would go stale the day somebody installs one. |
| Vehicle | `id` | Generated from the class name and the depot it starts at. A model names kinds of vehicle, not individual ones; naming them would make a model describe a garage rather than an operation. |
| Vehicle | `initial_state` | Hours already consumed when a driver came on duty. That is a fact about this morning, not about the operation, and SDD 6.4 makes it a per-run input. |
